idea-plugin.name: Claude Code sessions
idea-plugin.description:
Export and import Claude Code chat sessions - built for moving them to another machine and another user.
The plugin reads the local Claude Code session transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<project>/<sessionId>.jsonl), the per-session auxiliary folder next to each transcript and the file history behind checkpoints and /rewind (~/.claude/file-history/<sessionId>), lets you pick the conversations you want to move and writes them into a portable ZIP archive. On import, the sessions are attached to the local project folder you choose, conflicts are resolved the way you pick (skip, replace or import as a new copy) and the timestamps are shifted so the sessions show up as ones that just happened: run claude --resume from that folder and they are listed right away. Every import writes a diagnostic log.
  • Tools | Claude Code sessions | Export Sessions... pick one or more sessions and save the archive.
  • Tools | Claude Code sessions | Import Sessions... pick an archive, the target project folder and which sessions to restore.
The interface follows the language of the IDE or of the operating system: English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese and Korean.

Special thanks

A heartfelt thank you to my colleague and dear friend Antonio Petricca, who has followed this plugin since its very early stages: his suggestions shaped the design choices, and his field testing brought to light issues that no unit test would ever have detected. Thank you for the time and care you dedicated to it.
